findings: Encryption key versioning incomplete — Table exists but decrypt() does not use dek_version field. Cannot decrypt messages with old DEK versions. Implement versioned DEK lookup in decrypt() to fetch correct DEK from encryption_key_versions table.

Outbox poller not integrated into application startup — OutboxPoller.start() must be called in FastAPI lifespan event. Events currently accumulate in memory and are never delivered. Implement startup hook to instantiate and start poller with registered handlers.

Identity resolver must switch from in-memory to RLS-enforced database queries — Currently maintains thread-local dicts that evaporate on restart. Refactor resolve_or_create() to query customers table; RLS policy will enforce tenant isolation automatically.

PII re-hydration not connected to response generation — Redacted tokens are generated during ingestion but not replaced with plaintext values in responses sent to end users (chat widget, Zendesk write-back). Implement re_hydrate() calls before sending response to client.
